blocks.text: How an Adult Gets a Texas Driver License
heading_path: Driving Lessons for Adults in Texas
How an Adult Gets a Texas Driver License

blocks.text: Adults do not go through the learner and provisional stages that under-18s do. There is no six-month holding period and no supervised-hours log — the route is short. Here is what it takes, from the course to the driving test.

blocks.text: Best Driving School is a DPS-authorized third party testing provider, so you can take the official skills test with us in Plano rather than waiting for a DPS appointment. Bring your valid Texas restricted license, the driver education certificate for the course you completed, and an ITAD certificate dated within 90 days.

Can an adult take driving lessons with no previous experience?

blocks.text: Yes. Our adult beginner driving lessons start with the vehicle, controls, and basic actions needed to move safely — adjusting the seat and mirrors, understanding the controls, and steering at low speeds — before progressing to residential roads, intersections, and busier traffic.

Can I take driving lessons if I already have a license?
